title: Generative AI in the Workplace: Replacement or Augmentation of Human Jobs?
description: With rapid adoption of LLMs and generative AI tools across engineering, content, and finance, evaluate whether generative AI will cause mass white-collar job displacement or primarily augment productivity and create higher-value roles.
key_angles: Automation of repetitive cognitive tasks vs. emergence of new specialized AI operations roles
Widening wage disparity between AI-fluent and non-fluent professionals
Historical precedents of technological disruption (industrial revolution, cloud transition)
Need for rapid curriculum overhaul in universities and corporate reskilling

title: Remote vs. Office-First: What is the Optimal Future of Work for Tech Teams?
description: Major tech firms have diverged between strict return-to-office mandates and remote-first policies. Debate which model best fosters long-term innovation, mentorship for junior engineers, work-life balance, and operational efficiency.
key_angles: Serendipitous collaboration and junior onboarding in physical spaces
Access to global talent pools and elimination of grueling metropolitan commutes
Mental health, employee retention, and boundary erosion in work-from-home settings
Asynchronous productivity metrics vs. hours-at-desk surveillance cultures

title: Data Privacy vs. National Security: Should End-to-End Encryption Have Backdoors?
description: Governments frequently call for lawful interception capabilities or backdoors into encrypted communication platforms, while privacy advocates argue backdoors inherently undermine cybersecurity for all citizens.
key_angles: Law enforcement requirements to combat cybercrime, terrorism, and financial fraud
Mathematical and architectural vulnerabilities created by any cryptographic escrow backdoor
Civil liberties, freedom of speech, and protection against authoritarian overreach
Alternative investigative techniques that do not compromise fundamental protocol security

title: Quantum Computing: Are We Prepared for the Post-RSA Cryptographic Era?
description: As quantum computing approaches operational readiness, traditional public-key cryptography (RSA, ECC) faces obsolescence. Evaluate the readiness of modern banking and global infrastructure to adopt post-quantum cryptography.
key_angles: Harvest now, decrypt later attacks against stored sensitive enterprise data
Implementation complexity and computational overhead of NIST lattice-based algorithms
Vulnerability of blockchain, digital currencies, and legacy financial settlement networks
Disparity between nation-states in quantum hardware research

title: Open Source vs. Proprietary AI Models: Balancing Innovation and Safety
description: Debate whether releasing open-weights AI foundation models democratizes research and innovation or presents uncontrollable safety, biosecurity, and misinformation hazards compared to closed API models.
key_angles: Democratization of developer tooling and reduction of Big Tech monopolies
Irreversibility of releasing open weights capable of generating malicious exploits
Community-driven security audits vs. corporate red-teaming standards
Global regulatory compliance frameworks (EU AI Act, US Executive Orders)

title: Gig Economy & Platform Workers: Flexible Freedom or Unregulated Exploitation?
description: The rapid expansion of app-based delivery and ride-hailing services has transformed urban employment. Discuss whether platform work represents entrepreneurial autonomy or an absence of social safety nets requiring statutory labor rights.
key_angles: Autonomy of choosing work hours and low entry barriers for rural-to-urban youth
Lack of minimum wage guarantees, health insurance, provident fund, and accident coverage
Algorithmic management, ratings surveillance, and arbitrary account deactivations
Impact of statutory welfare board bills (e.g. Rajasthan Gig Workers Act) on platform viability

title: Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDC): The End of Cash and Rise of State Surveillance?
description: Central banks worldwide, including the RBI with the Digital Rupee, are rolling out sovereign digital currencies. Debate whether CBDCs streamline monetary settlements or threaten financial anonymity and civil liberties.
key_angles: Reduction in physical currency printing, handling, and counterfeit expenses
Direct benefit transfer (DBT) efficiency and programmable targeted subsidies
Programmability and transactional tracking eroding constitutional privacy
Systemic bank run risks during liquidity panics if retail depositors bypass commercial banks

title: Rapid Industrial Growth vs. Environmental Sustainability: A Developing Nation Dilemma
description: Developing economies face pressure from developed nations to rapidly achieve net-zero carbon goals while simultaneously striving to lift hundreds of millions out of poverty through energy-intensive manufacturing.
key_angles: Historical cumulative carbon emissions of developed nations vs. per-capita emissions in Global South
Economic necessity of thermal power and heavy manufacturing for job creation
Severe local public health and climate vulnerability consequences of unchecked industrialization
Green financing, technology transfer obligations, and renewable energy capital investment

title: Free Higher Education vs. Market-Driven University Tuition: Who Should Pay?
description: With student debt crises rising globally, debate whether higher education should be treated as a fundamental public good funded through taxation or as a private investment borne by individual graduates.
key_angles: Higher education as an engine of social mobility and national productivity
Fiscal strain on state budgets and potential quality dilution in underfunded public universities
Income-share agreements (ISAs) and targeted means-tested scholarships vs. universal subsidies
Accountability of educational institutions when students bear direct tuition costs

title: Universal Basic Income (UBI): Effective Poverty Eradication or Economic Disincentive?
description: Evaluate the viability of a universal, unconditional cash transfer to all citizens as a buffer against technological unemployment and deep structural poverty.
key_angles: Administrative simplicity and elimination of bureaucratic leakages in conditional welfare schemes
Enormous fiscal burden requiring radical tax restructuring or deficit expansion
Empirical evidence on labor supply elasticity: does unconditional cash reduce work incentives?
Targeted basic services (health, education, nutrition) vs. direct unconditional cash payouts

title: Red is Better than Blue
description: A classic corporate campus placement abstract topic. Tests candidate creativity, symbolic reasoning, multi-dimensional thinking, and the ability to articulate structured arguments from metaphor.
key_angles: Symbolism of Red: passion, urgency, dynamism, revolution, energy, and action
Symbolism of Blue: tranquility, stability, logic, depth, trust, and institutional authority
Business strategy perspective: Red Ocean (head-to-head competition) vs. Blue Ocean (uncontested market spaces)
Synthesis: Sustainable leadership requires balancing the proactive drive of red with the analytical composure of blue

title: Silence Speaks Louder than Words
description: Debate the power of restraint, active listening, non-verbal presence, and deliberate pauses against explicit verbal assertiveness in leadership and high-stakes negotiations.
key_angles: Active listening as the core differentiator of persuasive consensus builders
Silence as complicity when standing against injustice or organizational malpractice
Non-verbal authority and emotional regulation in high-pressure leadership scenarios
The necessity of articulate, timely, and courageous verbal intervention

title: The Best Way to Predict the Future is to Create It
description: Evaluate Abraham Lincoln and Peter Drucker's famous aphorism in the context of technological disruption, entrepreneurial agency, deterministic planning, and unforeseen systemic shocks.
key_angles: Proactive innovation and visionary entrepreneurship bending market trajectories
Unintended second-order consequences and systemic unpredictability (black swan events)
Iterative resilience and agile adaptation vs. rigid prescriptive five-year blueprints
Individual accountability vs. external macro-economic and geopolitical constraints

title: Innovation vs. Imitation: Which Drives Market Success?
description: Analyze whether first-mover breakthrough innovation or smart fast-follower imitation and execution is the true determinant of enduring commercial triumph.
key_angles: High capital burn and market education burdens borne by pioneer innovators
Fast-follower advantage: refining user experience, optimizing unit economics, and avoiding pioneer mistakes
True technological leaps that establish unassailable intellectual property moats
Creative recombination: how imitation often evolves into transformative innovation

title: Rules are Made to be Broken
description: Examine the tension between institutional discipline, ethical boundaries, and disruptive breakthrough thinking in organizations and society.
key_angles: Disruptive entrepreneurship questioning legacy dogmas to unlock non-linear breakthroughs
Organizational safety, aviation, and financial regulations forged from catastrophic past failures
First understanding the purpose of a rule before attempting to reform or discard it
The boundary between constructive paradigm disruption and reckless ethical breach
